title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
overview:
Dare to Walk on the Dangerous Side of the Street

Features:
- 12 fierce Street Fighters in all:
- new special attacks, super combos and counterattacks
- a new mix of classic and intense new competitors
- A precise translation of the No. 1 smash arcade hit
- fantastic, next generation speed and control
- All new eye popping art, animation and blasting sound effects
- 2 modes of play: Arcade (1 player) and Versus mode (2 player).
- New training mode for practicing multi-hit combos and strategies.
